description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: test/zaq/engine/connect/*, test/zaq/accounts/* affected tests, existing Engine API/OAuth boundary tests, docs/architecture.md, docs/services/engine.md, docs/services/system-config.md, docs/QUALITY_SCORE.md only with new evidence. Consolidate slice acceptance suite through real context boundaries; all previous steps remain individually test-first and documented, not deferred to this task. Add a Connect service deep-dive and AGENTS documentation map entry if existing engine documentation cannot keep contracts discoverable. Do not create another execution plan file; Beadwork is authoritative.

Tests to add before implementation: canonical integration scenarios existing legacy unchanged, optional Alice personal/Bob global, required with and without org grant, non-Person resolution, invalid/revoked personal no fallback, revoke versus remove, policy transitions retaining grants, concurrent current-slot uniqueness, OAuth reconnect/refresh, merge cleanup, and committed event delivery. Assert resolved objects can supply generic api_key/oauth2/jwt_bearer authentication without ReqLLM options; consumer simulation uses actual resolver and subscriber boundary, not an Agent implementation. Security sentinel checks raw DB ciphertext, DTOs, inspected structs/changesets, event/Oban args, logs and telemetry. Explicitly cover malicious nested metadata and provider error bodies. Regression existing HTTP/data-source/MCP org/user grant tests and OAuth flows; no policy change imposed on old resource-bound consumers.

Branches/paths validated: migration expand/rollback safety, incomplete canonical setup unavailable, resolver no legacy competing source, Person operations authenticated and redacted, transactional failure does not publish, node/subscriber reconnection limitations honestly documented. Trace PRD foundation requirements 5-10, 13, 16, 24-25, 30-36, 43, 48, 51, 55, 62-69 to test names; broader AI rollout/Agent invalidation/UI requirements explicitly deferred. No claims of 96-case completeness without assertion of selected grant/error in generated matrix.

Mocking plan: real DB/Oban/PubSub/identity boundaries; only external OAuth HTTP mocked. Use focused mix test during steps; run mix format after code edits and final mix q, record exact outputs and changed-file coverage >=95%. If environment blocks checks, retain issue open and document command/blocker; never mark done based on intention. UI/E2E tests deferred unless backend changes touch existing callback/controller behavior requiring its current integration tests; no new Person screens.

Documentations to update: public/internal boundary distinction, schema mode rationale, safe errors, policy table, backend function signatures, OAuth attempt lifecycle, mutation delivery and reconciliation limitations, migration precedence. Handoff specifies next AI slice must migrate global grants before Connect-only runtime reads, subscribe all Agent owning nodes, track credential/person/grant IDs without secrets, stop lazily and solve creation/mutation race; separate workflow Actor issue remains separate. Definition of done for THIS slice excludes actual Agent invalidation, BO and Person UI. Record decisions/coverage exceptions in epic and PR, do not close epic until implemented and validated.

2026-09-14 FINAL USER-APPROVED STORAGE DECISION: canonical grants reuse owner_type/owner_id (org with NULL ID or person with non-null ID) and resource_type=connect_credential/resource_id=credential_id string. Native type/shape and explicit non-null/equality CHECKs plus existing credential_id FK; partial unique org/person slots across statuses. No binding_type, duplicate person_id, extra Person FK, triggers or guard rows. Server derives resource pair and configuration auth fields; secret_binding stays independent. Trusted canonical storage checks literal current active Person, without authenticating callers or resolving aliases. Concurrent orphan grants/secrets are an accepted residual risk. IDs must not be reused operationally; no silent reidentification through stale aliases; synchronous erasure is not guaranteed. Later resolver must check Person exists/eligible BEFORE policy selection even disabled, and missing/stale Person errors NEVER fall back globally. Authenticated writes and OAuth/refresh must recheck current identity; lifecycle cleanup/reconciliation and later distributed server invalidation remain unimplemented in storage task .1.

comments.text: Superseding acceptance architecture: no grant binding_type/person_id or duplicate owner equality. Canonical resource_type=connect_credential and resource_id=credential_id::text are derived server-side and DB checked; owner_type/owner_id identify Person. Expand acceptance to real independent transaction isolation schedules, both parent/grant orders, owner reference updates, parent PK updates, rollback, canonical equality/null bypass, and all-status uniqueness. Proposed key-share plus reverse RESTRICT SQL triggers demonstrably orphan under REPEATABLE READ; see docs/services/connect-person-trigger-blocker.md. Existing successful FK-based tests do not validate the revision. Retain every other acceptance/security/handoff requirement; lifecycle remains later and secret_binding independent.
